column1: Heat the avocado oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the onion until soft.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, then stir in the garlic.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer until slightly thickened.
Make 5 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Sprinkle the mozzarella over the top, cover, and cook until the egg whites are set and the cheese is melted.
